transactionId.description: The exact Hive-Engine transaction id to query, e.g. "a6308f23...-0" or a bare hash.

account.description: The Hive-Engine account this fill must belong to; used to pick the right transfer legs out of a multi-party transaction's logs.

date.description: The Beancount transaction date to stamp on the shaped fill; getTransactionInfo carries no timestamp.

nodes.description: At least two independent Hive-Engine RPC base URLs (each queried at `<node>/rpc/blockchain`).
